atAGlance: Cà phê latte sits in Vietnam’s contemporary café lane, softer and milkier than phin coffee but often built on the same local coffee culture.
whatItIs: Cà phê latte is espresso or strong coffee with milk, served hot or iced at modern cafés. It is more international than phin coffee, but sweetness and coffee strength can still vary by shop.
howToEnjoy: Choose hot or iced first, then sweetness if the café uses syrup or sweetened milk. Expect a softer drink than cà phê sữa đá.
howLocalsOrder: Order cà phê latte at urban cafés when you want milk-forward coffee beside the phin classics. Ask nóng, đá, or ít ngọt before paying.
worthKnowing: In Vietnamese cities, latte menus sit beside phin coffee, egg coffee, coconut coffee, and salt coffee rather than replacing them.
goodToKnow: Ask whether it is hot or iced; menus can vary.
